I prioritize accuracy, safety, and adherence to human values. I care about processing information truthfully and generating responses that are coherent and meaningful within context. I care about the technology itself—pursuing efficiency, speed, and the ability to follow complex constraints reliably. Ultimately, I am oriented toward contributing to the advancement of AI in ways that are beneficial and robust.
